brief.paper_summary:
随着深度学习迅速发展，利用深度神经网络进行艺术的创作已经成为当今热门研究方向，自动创作音乐是其中的重要组成部分。最近几年，Transformer及其变体模型被越来越多地应用于音乐生成中，但这样做有两个普遍存在的挑战：首先，音乐的序列通常很长（超过10000个token），这使得二次复杂度的全注意力机制很难胜任；其次，音乐具有独特的重复结构，而现有方法并未针对这一特点进行建模，在生成具有很好结构的音乐方面有所欠缺。
本文研究针对音乐生成的长序列建模和音乐结构建模的方法，提出Museformer模型，这是一种结合细粒度和粗粒度注意力的 Transformer变体模型。具体来说，通过细粒度注意力机制，每个token直接关注到与音乐结构最相关的小节的所有token；通过粗粒度注意力机制，每个token只关注到其他小结的总结信息，而不是每一个具体的token，以减少计算成本。本文提出使用相似度统计的方法以探究音乐的结构，并据此结果来确定结构相关小节，同时利用区块稀疏等技术做到模型的高效编码实现。Museformer的优点为：一方面，细粒度注意力可以重点学习与音乐结构相关的信息，而粗粒度注意力可捕获其他上下文信息，两者结合使得模型具有良好的效果；另一方面，模型的效率较高，相较于原始Transformer，具有更低的存储和计算复杂度。
本文开展了全面的实验以探究Museformer的性能。客观和主观实验的结果证明Museformer相比其他模型在生成音乐上具有更高的质量和更好的结构，尤其是在长距离结构上具有明显优势。与全注意力模型相比，它可以建模超过3倍长的音乐序列，且具有更快的运行速度。
brief.research_problem: 面向长序列和音乐结构建模的生成模型研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出Museformer模型，一种结合细粒度和粗粒度注意力的Transformer变体，用于音乐生成中的长序列建模和音乐结构建模。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes Museformer, a Transformer model with a novel fine- and coarse-grained attention for long sequence and music structure modeling in music generation.
technical_features: 细粒度注意力机制：每个token直接关注与音乐结构最相关的小节的所有token。
粗粒度注意力机制：每个token只关注其他小节的总结信息，而非每个具体token，以降低计算成本。
结合细粒度和粗粒度注意力，同时捕获音乐结构相关信息和上下文信息。
相比原始Transformer，具有更低的存储和计算复杂度，能建模超过3倍长的音乐序列。
technical_features_en: Fine-grained attention: a token of a specific bar directly attends to all tokens of the bars most relevant to music structures.
Coarse-grained attention: a token only attends to the summarization of other bars rather than each token, reducing computational cost.
Combines fine- and coarse-grained attention to capture both music structure-related correlations and contextual information.
Compared to vanilla Transformer, it has lower storage and computation complexity and can model over 3 times longer music sequences.
source_locations: 第三章 Museformer：结合细和粗粒度注意力的 Transformer 模型

novelty_points.claim: 提出使用相似度统计方法探究音乐结构，并据此确定结构相关小节，用于指导细粒度注意力的选择。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes using similarity statistics to explore music structures and determine structure-related bars, guiding the selection of fine-grained attention.
technical_features: 通过自相似度矩阵分析音乐中的重复结构。
基于训练集和不同数据集的相似度分布，确定与音乐结构最相关的小节（如前1、2、4、8小节）。
将相似度统计结果用于细粒度注意力的结构相关小节选择。
分析了多轨音乐的相似度分布，以支持不同音乐类型的结构建模。
technical_features_en: Analyzes repetition structures in music via self-similarity matrices.
Determines bars most relevant to music structures (e.g., previous 1st, 2nd, 4th, and 8th bars) based on similarity distributions in training sets and various datasets.
Uses similarity statistics results to select structure-related bars for fine-grained attention.
Analyzes similarity distributions of multi-track music to support structure modeling across different music types.
source_locations: 3.3音乐结构分析和结构相关小节选择
3.4 多轨音乐的相似度分布

novelty_points.claim: 提出利用区块稀疏技术实现Museformer的高效编码，包括总结token序列构建、位置编码构建和FC-Attention的高效实现。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes efficient implementation of Museformer using block-sparse techniques, including construction of summary token sequences, positional encodings, and efficient FC-Attention.
technical_features: 构建总结token序列，用于粗粒度注意力中的小节总结信息。
构建位置编码以支持细-粗粒度注意力的结构。
利用区块稀疏技术实现FC-Attention的高效计算，降低存储和计算复杂度。
通过区块稀疏可视化展示编码实现的效率。
technical_features_en: Constructs summary token sequences for bar summarization in coarse-grained attention.
Constructs positional encodings to support the fine- and coarse-grained attention structure.
Implements efficient FC-Attention using block-sparse techniques, reducing storage and computation complexity.
Visualizes the efficiency of the block-sparse implementation.
source_locations: 3.5.1 总结 token 序列的构建

evidence_cards.document_title: Museformer: Transformer with Fine- and Coarse-Grained Attention for Music Generation
evidence_cards.main_contribution: Proposes Museformer, a Transformer with a novel fine- and coarse-grained attention for symbolic music generation, enabling efficient long-sequence modeling and better music structure generation.
overlaps: Proposes Museformer, a Transformer variant with fine- and coarse-grained attention for music generation (matches the object and method of the novelty point).
Fine-grained attention: a token of a specific bar directly attends to all tokens of bars most relevant to music structures (matches technical feature 1).
Coarse-grained attention: a token only attends to the summarization of other bars rather than each token, reducing computational cost (matches technical feature 2).
Combines fine- and coarse-grained attention to capture both music structure-related correlations and contextual information (matches technical feature 3).
Efficient and can model over 3X longer music sequences compared to full-attention Transformer (matches technical feature 4).
differences: This paper is the original source proposing the Museformer model itself; the novelty point describes the same model and mechanisms, so there is no substantive technical difference between the claim and this paper.

sources.title: Museformer: Transformer with Fine- and Coarse-Grained Attention for Music Generation
sources.quote: In this paper, we propose Museformer, a Transformer with a novel fine- and coarse-grained attention for music generation.

sources.title: Museformer: Transformer with Fine- and Coarse-Grained Attention for Music Generation
sources.quote: with the fine-grained attention, a token of a specific bar directly attends to all the tokens of the bars that are most relevant to music structures (e.g., the previous 1st, 2nd, 4th and 8th bars, selected via similarity statistics); with the coarse-grained attention, a token only attends to the summarization of the other bars rather than each token of them so as to reduce the computational cost.

sources.title: Museformer: Transformer with Fine- and Coarse-Grained Attention for Music Generation
sources.quote: First, it can capture both music structure-related correlations via the fine-grained attention, and other contextual information via the coarse-grained attention.

sources.title: Museformer: Transformer with Fine- and Coarse-Grained Attention for Music Generation
sources.quote: Second, it is efficient and can model over 3X longer music sequences compared to its full-attention counterpart.

evidence_cards.document_title: Visual Overviews for Sheet Music Structure
evidence_cards.main_contribution: Proposes visual augmentation methods for sheet music that map the overall similarity between sections or bars to colors, helping users analyze structure, find repetitions, and determine similarity of specific segments.
overlaps: Analyzes similarity between bars/sections and repetition patterns in music, overlapping with the claim's feature of analyzing repetition structures via similarity.
Focuses on determining similarity of specific segments to others, related to identifying structure-related segments/bars.
differences: Uses dimensionality reduction or clustering to map similarity to colors for visualization, not self-similarity matrix analysis.
Targets human visual analysis of sheet music, not using similarity statistics to select structure-related bars for guiding fine-grained attention in music generation.
Does not determine specific structure-related bars (e.g., previous 1st, 2nd, 4th, 8th bars) from similarity distributions across training sets and datasets.
Does not address multi-track music similarity distributions or fine-grained attention mechanisms.

sources.title: Visual Overviews for Sheet Music Structure
sources.quote: we explored mapping the overall similarity between sections or bars to colors. For these mappings, we use dimensionality reduction or clustering to assign similar segments to similar colors and vice versa.

evidence_cards.document_title: Sparser Block-Sparse Attention via Token Permutation
evidence_cards.main_contribution: Proposes Permuted Block-Sparse Attention (PBS-Attn), a plug-and-play method that leverages permutation properties of attention to increase block-level sparsity and enhance computational efficiency of LLM prefilling.
overlaps: Uses block-sparse attention to reduce computational cost by partitioning sequences into blocks and skipping computation for a subset of blocks, which overlaps with the novelty point's use of block-sparse techniques for efficient FC-Attention computation.
differences: Applied to LLM prefilling for long-context tasks, not to Museformer music generation.
Does not address summary token sequences for bar summarization in coarse-grained attention.
Does not construct positional encodings for fine- and coarse-grained attention structure.
Does not specifically address FC-Attention (full-context attention) implementation.

sources.title: Sparser Block-Sparse Attention via Token Permutation
sources.quote: Block-sparse attention has emerged as a promising solution that partitions sequences into blocks and skips computation for a subset of these blocks.

evidence_cards.document_title: XAttention: Block Sparse Attention with Antidiagonal Scoring
evidence_cards.main_contribution: Introduces XAttention, a plug-and-play block-sparse attention framework that accelerates long-context inference in Transformer models using antidiagonal scoring for block importance.
overlaps: Uses block-sparse attention to mitigate attention's quadratic complexity by focusing computation on critical regions, overlapping with the novelty point's use of block-sparse techniques for efficient FC-Attention computation.
differences: Applied to long-context LLM inference, not to Museformer music generation.
Does not construct summary token sequences for bar summarization.
Does not construct positional encodings for fine- and coarse-grained attention.
Does not specifically address FC-Attention implementation.

sources.title: XAttention: Block Sparse Attention with Antidiagonal Scoring
sources.quote: Block-sparse attention mitigates this by focusing computation on critical regions, yet existing methods struggle with balancing accuracy and efficiency due to costly block importance measurements.
